description: Slot counts on one page: Sl holds 253 one-column Boolean rows. Four single inserts bring it to 254, 255, 256 and 257 rows; then one row (the 101st) is deleted through a table recordset, and one row is inserted. Asks what happens at each count (same page, new page, slot reuse) in the closed file. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it.
retentionNote: Designed r-fmt-2-pres-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
